skills.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike
skills.desc:
Press  to launch this attack.
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the joystick to attack while moving. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

skills.name: Dodge: Safety Regulation
skills.desc:
Press  to dodge:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Quick Inspection
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Slide forward while shooting, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Violation Penalty
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Incident Management
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the on-field character is launched in the air, press  to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Evasive Assist: Rapid Risk Response
skills.desc:
Assist
Evasive Assist
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Counter Volt Needle
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Throws a grenade to the front, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Leap in the air and throw two grenades to the front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the joystick to change directions.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Collaborative Construction
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Demolition Blast - Beware
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Pre-Driven Needle
skills.desc: When Grace's Basic Attack or Dash Attack hits an enemy and deals Physical DMG, she gains 1 stack of Zap (up to 8 stacks). Upon reaching maximum stacks, using a Special Attack or EX Special Attack will consume all stacks of Zap, increasing the accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by X%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Tech Support Dept.
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Upon hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack, the next Shock effect inflicted on the target increases Shock DMG by 18%. This effect can stack up to 2 times, and each enemy can trigger it once per skill use. Resets when the Shock effect ends.

cons.name: Recharge Chamber
cons.desc:
When the 4th hit of Grace's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain 0.25 Energy.
Within the same move, this effect can grant a max of 2 Energy to all squad members.

cons.name: Lightning Piercer
cons.desc: When Grace's grenade hits an enemy during a Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, the target's Electric RES is reduced by 8.5%, and Electric Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.

cons.name: Chief Mechanic
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Burst Capacitor
cons.desc:
When Grace uses her EX Special Attack, she gains 6 stacks of Charge (max 6 stacks).
When her Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike or Dash Attack: Quick Inspection hits an enemy, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing her Energy Generation Rate of the attack by 20%.

cons.name: Frosty Cold Iron Witch
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Detonation Trigger
cons.desc: When all Zap stacks are consumed to activate a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, Grace's skill is enhanced, tossing an extra grenade and increasing each grenade's DMG to 200%.
